description: This file contains unit tests for the Log model in the Goteo project, verifying creation, validation, deletion, and appending of log entries.

classes.name: LogTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the Log model, testing log creation, validation, deletion, and appending functionalities.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests the instantiation of the Log class.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Tests the validation and saving process of a Log object.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new Log object, validating, saving, and retrieving it.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a Log object from the database.

methods.name: testNonExisting

methods.name: testAppend
methods.description: Tests appending a new Log entry with session user context and handling exceptions.
